subject: english
title: Word Roots · Q3 W09 D01
objective: Identify a base word, or root, in common related words.
introduction: Milo is a word detective! 🐱✨ Find the small base word hiding inside bigger words like looked.

vocabulary.definition: to use your eyes to see

activities.instruction: Watch how a base word stays the same in related words!
activities.content: A root or base word carries the central meaning. Word endings can change how the word is used.

items.prompt: Which pair shows a root word and a related word?
items.explanation: Look is the base word, and looked is made from it, so the pair shares a root.

items.prompt: Which is the base word in 'looked'?
items.explanation: Looked is look with -ed added, so look is the base word.

items.prompt: Which word was made from the root 'look'?
items.explanation: Looked is made from the root look by adding -ed.

items.prompt: Which pair does NOT belong with the others?
items.explanation: "cat — dog" names two animals, not a word family. The other pairs share a base word and a related word.

items.prompt: What is the root word of 'painter'?
items.explanation: Painter is paint with -er added, so paint is the base word.
